newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges back, others flat in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges back, others flat in late trade.

text.p: Copper prices slipped back slightly in late inter-office trade on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Wednesday.
Other base metals were barely changed from the afternoon kerb closes.
Three month copper futures were quoted at $1,910/15 by 1800 GMT from $1,918 at the end of the late kerb and $1,890 at the kerb close on Tuesday.
Traders attributed Wednesday's gains to short-covering after sharp losses earlier in the week.

The fact that the market appeared to be struggling to get much higher suggested to some that the bounce would be unconvincing. But others said expectations of further sizeable stock drawdowns this week and next could lend support.
